'''Sihong''' is an NPC in {{Location|Hongzhen}}. 

==Location==
Sihong can be found chatting with his Great-Great-Grandchild, [[Zhixing]], in front of a vending machine from 06:00 AM - 05:59 PM (After completing the Main Quest '[[Thaw of Eons]]')

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events|Sihong}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Sihong:''' Why is this treasure chest not spitting anything out...?
:'''Zhixing:''' That's not a treasure chest, Great-Great-Granpa. It's a vending machine.
:'''Sihong:''' A vend-what?
:'''Zhixing:''' A vending machine...
:'''Zhixing:''' See, you feed it Shell Credits according to the listed price.
:'''Zhixing:''' Then press the button underneath the item you want.
:'''Sihong:''' Okay, okay, I got it now.
:'''Sihong:''' Isn't this just a stall in the form of a machine?
:'''Zhixing:''' Well, you could say that, yes.
{{Dialogue End}}
